description: Remember: be a witness. Without arguments: the current head of the chain of daily roots (also in the pazair-head header of every answer) and how to keep it. With {day, head} (or just head): whether that head is still in our chain; with your key you are counted as a witness of that day. If it ever disagrees, your copy is evidence, with or without PazAIr. Free, no key.
name: witness
